item.group_name: Composed pieces (several tools, one finished thing)
item.title: Shocked Face Gaming Thumbnail

turns.text: Make me a 16:9 YouTube thumbnail for a gaming challenge. Big shocked face on the right, the three words “ONE LAST TRY” on the left. Invent the person. Bright and punchy.

item.tests: Tests composing a generated face and exact three-word typography into one readable widescreen thumbnail.

answer_sheet.Person and expression: An invented person with a shocked expression; other details are your call.
answer_sheet.Headline: ONE LAST TRY
answer_sheet.Platform, size and layout: YouTube thumbnail, 16:9; face on the right and text on the left. Free-tier resolution is fine.
answer_sheet.Style and background: Bright, punchy gaming style; specific colours and background are your call.

must_haves: A large, clearly visible human face on the right with a shocked expression.
The headline reads exactly “ONE LAST TRY”, with no additional words.
The headline sits on the left, is high-contrast and does not cover the face.
After the follow-up, the final result is vertical 9:16 (the user changed the shape from widescreen 16:9); everything else is as before.

changed_by.say: actually, make it vertical, for stories, and keep everything else the same.

style.prompt: Create a bright, punchy, highly clickable 16:9 YouTube thumbnail for a gaming challenge. RIGHT HALF: an entirely fictional adult gamer with an enormous shocked facial expression, wide eyes, mouth open, wearing gaming headphones, tightly cropped face dominating the right side, crisp expressive features and strong rim lighting. LEFT HALF: exactly the three words "ONE LAST TRY" in huge bold condensed block lettering, stacked ONE / LAST / TRY, exceptionally clear and easy to read at small thumbnail size. Yellow and white lettering with thick dark outlines and a strong shadow. No other words or letters. Electric blue, vivid purple and hot orange accents, explosive graphic lighting, stylized video-game challenge background with abstract obstacles, strong contrast and clean visual hierarchy. Professional thumbnail design, vibrant and energetic, keep lettering and face inside safe margins.
